meta.name: reviewer-framework
meta.description: This skill should be loaded when running or orchestrating a review. Defines confidence scoring, severity levels, finding output format, and the deduplication and coalescing rules orchestrators apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规范审查结果输出与去重
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要在多人协作审查时统一标准
copy.tagline_en: Standardize review scoring and report format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to align standards across reviewers

howto.what: 执行代码或内容评审时,Claude 会按固定格式输出问题清单:每条问题标出严重程度、置信度(0–100)、文件位置、问题说明和改法建议;并按严重程度排序,最后汇总数量。若同时跑了多类评审,重复问题会被合并。
howto.when: 当任务涉及运行或编排一次评审(例如代码或内容审查)时,此技能会被自动加载并使用。

say.text: 请按严重级别列出这个项目的代码问题,并给出置信度分数。
say.note: Claude 会输出分级和评分的发现列表。

say.text: 评审这几处改动,把重复问题合并,并注明所有来源。
say.note: 重复项会被合并,来源保留。

say.text: 输出要包含文件行号、问题说明和修复建议,最后统计总数。
say.note: 报告按模板输出并附汇总行。

howto.what_en: During a review, Claude outputs findings this way: severity, 0–100 confidence, file:line, issue, fix suggestion; grouped by severity, ending with a total. Orchestrators merge duplicate findings from multiple review types.
howto.when_en: Loaded automatically when a review is run or orchestrated (e.g., code or content review).

say_en.text: List this project's code issues by severity, with a confidence score for each.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a graded, scored list.

say_en.text: Review these changes; merge duplicate findings and keep all sources.
Use file:line, issue explanation, and fix suggestion; end with a total count.
